day_shape: IAEA Board of Governors refers Iran to UN Security Council for first time in 20 years, Houthis seize Yemen's Mocha port on Bab al-Mandab, OFAC suspends three Iran general licences, and UK issues fresh Iran sanctions guidance.

threads.label: IAEA refers Iran to Security Council
threads.summary: The IAEA Board of Governors passed a resolution reporting Iran to the UN Security Council over non-proliferation breaches, the first such referral in 20 years. Russia's Vienna representative called the referral a violation of diplomatic propriety, while CSIS reported surging construction at a deeply buried complex near Natanz.

threads.label: US and UK Iran sanctions moves
threads.summary: OFAC indefinitely suspended three general licences and one licensing policy under the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations to align with US foreign policy shifts, while the UK FCDO republished statutory guidance for its Iran and Iran nuclear sanctions regimes. Iran's UN representative wrote to the Secretary-General calling US sanctions on 27 airlines "economic terrorism," and Reuters reported Iran routed $2–2.5bn through a China-based trade mechanism in the past year.

threads.label: Houthis seize Mocha, Bab al-Mandab
threads.summary: Anti-Houthi Yemeni government sources said Houthi forces took control of the Red Sea port of Mocha, with Yemeni government forces launching a new offensive aiming to retake Sanaa. Defa Press and IRIB claimed Ansarallah forces advanced 2,600 square kilometres across Taiz and Hodeidah and downed a Saudi reconnaissance drone in Hajjah.

threads.label: Ongoing US–Iran war and domestic debate
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported White House advisers warned Trump the Iran conflict could last through his presidency, while Trump accused Tehran of election interference and said the war would end after midterms. Iran International reported former presidents Rouhani and Khatami urging a public say on ending the war and moderate figures questioning its cost; Brent crude rose above $101 per barrel per IRIB.

threads.label: Iran strikes claims and IRGC messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press claimed CBS reported nine US fighter jets were damaged in Iranian missile strikes on a US base in Jordan, including eight F-15s and one A-10, and quoted MP Salimi promising Iran has "many surprises in store." The Jerusalem Post reported projectiles struck Sirik in southern Iran on Wednesday, and Khamenei's office published his message to Hezbollah's Secretary-General declaring "no path except jihad and resistance."

threads.label: Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the destruction of three Hamas weapons depots in Gaza, Hamas confirmed the death of Farah Hamed in a Gaza City strike, and Lebanese media reported one killed in an Israeli strike on a motorcycle in southern Lebanon. Netanyahu visited the Syrian border pledging to defeat Iran, Katz issued a message to Damascus, and Human Rights Watch said Hezbollah's cluster-munition use in northern Israel may have constituted a war crime.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and humanitarian aid
threads.summary: Iran International reported 18 Dastgerd prisoners face possible death sentences over prison unrest, an official saying war conditions are curbing hijab enforcement, and continued fallout from January's crackdown including body-bag imagery and a protester still unable to walk after 23 operations. WFP welcomed a USD 2 million emergency contribution from Japan to support 147,000 people affected by the recent conflict in Iran.
